reasons: With a 4 MC cap, semester 7 can hold only one course; CS3237 is Sem 1 only, so it must use semester 7.
CS3247 and CS4330 are both Sem 2 only and would both need semester 8, exceeding the 4 MC limit.
CS4330 also lacks a completed prerequisite, and no extra prerequisite can be fitted in time under the 4 MC cap.
